FN-CXC1ZJW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 244
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/03/2026
House Bill 244 as introduced would decrease utility gross receipts (UGR) tax and utility service
use (USU) tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund (ETF) by an estimated maximum of $2.3
million annually, based on information provided by the Auburn University Department of
Agricultural Economics and Rural Sociology, by exempting electricity used for commercial
greenhouses, pivot irrigation systems, and poultry houses from these taxes.
This bill would further decrease UGR and USU tax receipts to the ETF by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the cost and amount of natural gas used for commercial greenhouses,
pivot irrigation systems, and poultry houses which would be exempted from these taxes by this
bill.
